title: Sumbangan Keperluan Asas Sarawak (SKAS) 2026
amount_note: UKAS, 16 April 2026. Paid in three phases through S Pay Global for essential food at participating shops.
paragraphs: State payment. Anak Sarawak with identity-card status K, living in Sarawak. Household income RM5,000 or below. Single adult income RM2,500 or below. A senior aged 60 or older, without a spouse or children, with income RM5,000 or below. Recipients are drawn from federal Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah (STR) data.

Phases in 2026: 10 March, 25 May and 10 November. People on the STR list are included automatically. Check status on S Pay Global or sarawak.gov.my. Service Sarawak also describes a path for eligible people who are not on the STR list.
The Service Sarawak SKAS page still shows RM800, RM250 and RM400, and STR Phase 4 for 2024. Those are not the 2026 rates. A dedicated live page at sarawak.gov.my/skas was not confirmed.

title: Domestic electricity discount
amounts: 25% for domestic users, April to December 2026
amount_note: Announced with the SKAS increase. This discount is not the SKAS payment.
paragraphs: State cost-of-living measure for domestic electricity users. It runs from April to December 2026.

title: Rental discount for markets, stalls and state premises
amount_note: Announced with the SKAS increase. This discount is not the SKAS payment.
paragraphs: State measure. It covers markets and stalls under local authorities, and business premises under state statutory bodies.

title: Bantuan Kewangan Khas (BKK) for IPT students
amount_note: Paid twice a year through S Pay Global. This is not the federal child aid that also uses the initials BKK.
paragraphs: For diploma and first-degree students at IPTA and IPTS. There is no income cap.

title: Free laptop
unspecified: The laptop is given in kind. The official page does not state a ringgit value, so none is shown.
paragraphs: For first-year diploma or bachelor students only. Family income per person must be RM1,500 or below.

title: Book voucher
amount_note: The amount is on the Yayasan IPT page. The 2026 circular covers Foundation through PhD, with no income cap.
paragraphs: State book aid for IPT students, paid through S Pay Global.

title: Inisiatif Graduan Pulang Sarawak (IGPS)
amount_note: Claim within 60 days. The official name is IGPS.
paragraphs: State flight subsidy for the graduate return-to-Sarawak initiative.

title: Geran Kemasukan IPT
amount_note: Family income per person must be RM1,500 or below.
paragraphs: Covers certificate, matriculation, foundation, pre-diploma, diploma and bachelor programmes.

title: Selected-course tuition waiver at four institutions
amounts: RM15,000 a year, only if income per person is RM1,500 or below
amount_note: The stipend is RM5,000 for lodging and RM10,000 through S Pay Global. It is not paid to every student.
paragraphs: State FTES tuition waiver for selected courses at Swinburne, Curtin, UTS and i-CATS. It is not free study plus an allowance for every student at those four institutions.
There is no separate FTES application. The university forwards the names.

title: HDAS deposit assistance
amounts: Deposit of 10%, or a maximum of RM10,000
amount_note: Stated on the HDC page for HDAS.
paragraphs: State help for a first home, for B40 and M40 buyers. Buy an affordable home from a registered developer, or build on SPK or SPS land.
Apply through Mutiara on 082-313035.

title: Housing Deposit and Repayment Assistance Scheme (HDRAS)
unspecified: UKAS describes this scheme. The monthly repayment amount is not stated on the official HDC page, so no repayment figure is shown.
paragraphs: UKAS also uses the name Skim Bantuan Bayaran Balik (HDRAS). Eligibility includes sub-sale and auction homes priced below RM300,000.

title: SRAS rent assistance
amount_note: The student rate is on a UKAS page. It is not on the HDC SRAS webpage, which has almost no scheme text.
paragraphs: For IPTA and IPTS students renting in Kuching, Samarahan, Sibu, Bintulu or Miri.
The HDC form also covers PPR tenants with identity-card status K and income of RM4,556 or below. SRAS is not only a student payment.
The HDC gallery on 21 August 2026 pointed online applications to apply-sras.ireka.my.

title: Rumah Spektra Permata
amount_note: These are the official price and income band, not a cash grant.
paragraphs: State affordable home listed by HDC.

title: Spektra Lite and Spektra Medium
unspecified: Named in UKAS DUN answers. A selling price was not stated on the pages checked, so none is shown.
paragraphs: State housing products named alongside the other Spektra homes.

title: Sri Pertiwi
unspecified: No selling price was stated on the pages checked, so none is shown.
paragraphs: Named in UKAS DUN answers. UKAS and HDC put household income at up to RM10,000.

title: Senior Citizen Health Benefit (SCHB)
amounts: Up to RM500 a person a year
amount_note: Cashless outpatient treatment at panel clinics.
paragraphs: Identity-card status K, age 60 or older, household income RM7,000 or below, and no other outpatient cover.
Apply online on Service Sarawak. That page does not name iSarawakCare.

title: Kenyalang Gold Card (KGC)
unspecified: Participating merchants give discounts. The Service Sarawak page does not list the discount rates, so none are shown.
paragraphs: Identity-card status K, age 60 or older, and a permanent resident of Sarawak. People who qualify are entitled automatically. Activate the card online. The virtual card sits in SarawakPass.

title: Bantuan Ihsan Kematian (BIK)
amounts: RM1,800 to the next of kin
amount_note: For the family of a Kenyalang Gold Card holder who has died.
paragraphs: Claim within 4 months (120 days). The person who died must not receive a JPA death benefit, and must not have been living in a government institution.
Apply at Service Sarawak, a JKMS counter, a Resident, district or sub-district office, or a Service Sarawak centre.

title: Bantuan Ibu Bersalin (BIB)
paragraphs: Malaysian mother with identity-card status K, or the wife of a Malaysian with status K. The birth can be in or outside Sarawak. Gestation of at least 22 weeks. Apply within 3 months of delivery.
You need SarawakPass and S Pay Global. Apply on iSarawakCare.

title: Endowment Fund Sarawak (EFS)
amount_note: From 1 January 2026, applications are fully online. KPWK says manual and physical applications are no longer accepted.
paragraphs: Either parent, or both, must be Malaysian with identity-card status K. The child can be born in or outside Sarawak. Apply within 1 year of the birth.
Apply through Service Sarawak and the Sarawak government portal. KPWK says the money can be withdrawn at age 18 with MyKad at the bank. The exception is if the child dies before 18.

title: Bantuan Ketua Isi Rumah Wanita (KIRWaS)
amount_note: Two official pages state two amounts. Use the page you apply on.
paragraphs: Service Sarawak: income from RM1,169 to RM4,849, and not already a JKMS recipient. Apply on iSarawakCare.
JWKS: RM1,000 one-off for women entrepreneurs in hardcore poverty, with income of RM1,298 or below.

title: Sarawak Micro Credit Scheme (SMCS)
amount_note: Type 1 is for B40 borrowers. All sectors except agriculture.
paragraphs: State micro-credit. The two types cover different loan sizes and rates.

title: Geran Pelancaran / modal mikro
amount_note: JKMS economic programme, on the economic development branch page. Maximum RM5,000, one-off.
paragraphs: Service Sarawak also describes Geran Pelancaran as appliances. Apply on iSarawakCare or at a JKMS office.

title: Bantuan Am (BA)
amount_note: This range is on a JKMS rate-sheet attachment. It is not on the main JKMS HTML page.
paragraphs: State aid, handled at a JKMS office. Treat the range with care until you have the attachment in front of you.

title: Bantuan Belia-Beliawanis (BBB)
amount_note: This figure is on a JKMS rate-sheet attachment. It is not on the main JKMS HTML page.
paragraphs: State aid for youth, handled at a JKMS office.
